headword: {即日|そくじつ}{発送|はっそう}

definitions.explanation: Shipping or dispatching an order on the same day it is placed. A selling point commonly advertised by online retailers and mail-order services.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{即日|そくじつ}{発送|はっそう}⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧です。
examples.english: This product is available for same-day shipping.

examples.japanese: ⟦{午前中|ごぜんちゅう}→午前中：11495_gozenchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}すれば→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧{即日|そくじつ}{発送|はっそう}⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧。
examples.english: If you order before noon, we will ship the same day.

examples.japanese: {即日|そくじつ}{発送|はっそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{平日|へいじつ}→平日：03033_heijitsu⟧⟦のみ→のみ：06546_nomi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、ご⟦{了承|りょうしょう}→了承：11415_ryoushou⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please note that same-day shipping is available on weekdays only.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{即日|そくじつ}→即日：09661_sokujitsu⟧ (the same day, immediately) and ⟦{発送|はっそう}→発送：10458_hassou⟧ (shipping, dispatch). This is a standard e-commerce and logistics term seen on product pages and in order confirmations. The prefix ⟦{即日|そくじつ}→即日：09661_sokujitsu⟧ is productive and appears in many compounds: ⟦{即日|そくじつ}→即日：09661_sokujitsu⟧⟦{完売|かんばい}→完売：18954_kanbai⟧ (sold out same day), ⟦{即日|そくじつ}→即日：09661_sokujitsu⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧ (same-day response).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {即日|そくじつ}{発送|はっそう}⟦{可能|かのう}→可能：00175_kanou⟧: same-day shipping available
- {即日|そくじつ}{発送|はっそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to offer same-day shipping
- {即日|そくじつ}{発送|はっそう}⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: products eligible for same-day shipping

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{翌日|よくじつ}→翌日：17960_yokujitsu⟧⟦{配達|はいたつ}→配達：00084_haitatsu⟧: next-day delivery — delivery on the following day
- ⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧⟦{配送|はいそう}→配送：05464_haisou⟧: same-day delivery — focuses on the delivery arriving the same day, while {即日|そくじつ}{発送|はっそう} emphasizes the dispatch happening the same day
